Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.sms

Class SmsAdapterConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.sms.SmsAdapterConfiguration
@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false) @EnableConfigurationProperties(SmsOutboxProperties.class) public class SmsAdapterConfiguration extends Object
Wires the phone normaliser and the logging SmsSender of development and tests. The profile expressions make the three senders (logging, Twilio, SNS) mutually exclusive in every combination of profiles: the logging one only under dev or test and when neither gateway profile is active, Twilio unless SNS is also active, and SNS whenever it is active. With none of those profiles there is no sender at all and MissingSmsGatewayConfiguration stops the startup: a deployment never silently keeps its messages in memory.
